source.body:
<!-- work-order:scenarios/proofs.md:V5 -->
## Outcome
spike: prove M1 to M3, then M10, then the rest of the Messages laws in Bend 2.0.34, or record exactly what Bend rejects (prompt `.work/prompts/proofs-spike.md`; the laws, `model.bend` and `spec.bend` are human-owned and already in `proofs/messages/`)

## Acceptance
Scenarios: V5
Specification: [scenarios/proofs.md](https://github.com/saadshahd/roundup/blob/main/scenarios/proofs.md)

## Scope
`proofs/messages/PROOF.bend` and `proofs/messages/mutants/**` only; never `LAWS.bend`, `model.bend` or `spec.bend`

## Preserve
`bend proofs/messages/PROOF.bend` prints `ALL PROOFS CHECK` or the report names each law Bend rejects

## Dependencies
Bend 2.0.34 installed in `/tmp` per V1; (B6's rulings that `model.bend` encodes) merged; M3 is proved for the model's atomic record-and-type step, and the Rust's cut rests on's `b6_` tests

## Delivery
No implementation PR linked yet.

## Queue
Key: V5
Priority: 100
Migration state: waiting

Imported from the Work table. The issue-backed queue is being installed; this issue does not create a second Builder. Completion requires delivery evidence, not a matching test name.

goals.statement: On main, `bend proofs/messages/PROOF.bend` (Bend 2.0.34) checks a `def Laws.<name>` for M1, M2, M3 and M10, then M4 to M7 as stated in LAWS.bend, with no `@unsafe` or `?TODO`, and prints `ALL PROOFS CHECK`; or a committed written record names each law Bend rejects with the checker's `expected` and `observed`, where it stalled, what would unblock it and a rough cost.
goals.observer: A reviewer runs Bend 2.0.34 (installed under /tmp with BEND_NO_TELEMETRY=1) on `proofs/messages/PROOF.bend` at main and greps it for `@unsafe`/`?TODO` and for one `def Laws.` per law in LAWS.bend; for each law not proved, reads the committed rejection record.

goals.statement: For every law PROOF.bend proves, one mutant of `model.bend` in `proofs/messages/mutants/` drops that law's guard and makes `bend` print `SOME PROOFS FAIL` naming that law.
goals.observer: A reviewer runs Bend on PROOF.bend against each mutant under `proofs/messages/mutants/` and confirms the output names the expected law.

goals.statement: The spike's outcome is written down: per law PASS (with its mutant failing and the measured proof-check wall time) or FAIL (expected, observed, stall point, unblock, cost), so V6 knows which laws, if any, go to Quint.
goals.observer: A reviewer reads the merged V5 PR body or its committed report and finds one entry per LAWS.bend law with those fields.

goals.statement: `LAWS.bend`, `model.bend` and `spec.bend` are unchanged by the spike and no law is weakened.
goals.observer: `git diff <pre-spike main> <post-spike main> -- proofs/messages/LAWS.bend proofs/messages/model.bend proofs/messages/spec.bend` is empty for the V5 PR.

deliveries.title: V1: pin Bend 2.0.34 and install it with `just proofs-setup`
deliveries.body:
## Outcome
The proofs toolchain is pinned: `proofs/BEND_VERSION` holds `2.0.34`, and `just proofs-setup` installs that version into `proofs/.tools/` (git-ignored) from a checksum-verified download with `BEND_NO_TELEMETRY=1`, failing loudly naming the tool when the installed version is not the pin. No `sudo`, no shell file edited. Quint's pin (`proofs/QUINT_VERSION`) is out of scope until V6 is needed.

## Scope
`proofs/BEND_VERSION`, the `proofs-setup` recipe in `justfile`, its install script and shell tests, `.gitignore` for `proofs/.tools/`. Never `proofs/messages/**`.

## Acceptance
Scenarios: V1
Specification: [scenarios/proofs.md](https://github.com/saadshahd/roundup/blob/main/scenarios/proofs.md)
Observer: `loop/rules.sh`-style shell tests with a fake download: a matching version passes, a version mismatch exits 1 naming `bend`, a missing `curl` exits 1; and on a fresh checkout `just proofs-setup` leaves `proofs/.tools/` holding Bend 2.0.34.

## Preserve
`just check` stays green and needs no network for its existing steps; no floating `latest` anywhere; `proofs/messages/LAWS.bend`, `model.bend`, `spec.bend` and `PROOF.bend` unchanged.

## Queue
Key: V1
Priority: 90
Mode: implement
Provider: any

deliveries.title: V2: `just proofs` runs Bend on the Messages proofs and fails on anything but `ALL PROOFS CHECK`
deliveries.body:
## Outcome
`just proofs` is the proofs observer V5 names: it runs the pinned Bend on `proofs/messages/PROOF.bend` and exits 0 only when Bend prints `ALL PROOFS CHECK`; any other output, a missing file, a `PROOF.bend` holding `@unsafe` or `?TODO`, or a `LAWS.bend` law with no `def Laws.<name>` exits non-zero naming it. `just check` runs it once V5 has an outcome that checks (until then the recipe exists and its own tests run in `just check`). Quint handling is out of scope until V6 exists.

## Scope
The `proofs` recipe in `justfile`, its script and shell tests, and the `just check` wiring. Never `proofs/messages/**`.

## Acceptance
Scenarios: V2
Specification: [scenarios/proofs.md](https://github.com/saadshahd/roundup/blob/main/scenarios/proofs.md)
Observer: shell tests on a temporary copy of the `proofs/messages/` layout with a fake `bend`: a passing copy exits 0; copies with a missing file, `@unsafe`, `?TODO`, a law with no `def Laws.`, and a law deleted from `PROOF.bend` each exit non-zero naming the defect.

## Preserve
`just check` stays green on main and its runtime stays within its current budget plus the Bend run; `proofs/messages/LAWS.bend`, `model.bend` and `spec.bend` unchanged.

## Queue
Key: V2
Priority: 90
Mode: implement
Provider: any
